subject: physics
topicName: p9 states of matter and changes of state

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Density: The mass per unit volume of a substance, measured in kg/m³. Density tells us how compact a substance is. | Internal energy: The total kinetic energy and potential energy of all the particles in a substance. | Specific latent heat: The amount of energy required to change the state of 1 kg of a substance without changing its temperature. | Specific latent heat of fusion: The energy required to change 1 kg of a substance from solid to liquid (melt) at its melting point.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Foundation Describe the arrangement and movement of particles in a gas. | Foundation A metal block has a mass of 2.7 kg and a volume of 0.001 m³. Calculate its density in kg/m³. | Foundation Explain why the temperature of a substance does not change while it is melting, even though energy is being supplied.
